verdict.rationale: The gateway is largely API-first: model access, provider routing, caching, BYOK, and even a keyless public models endpoint are confirmed to work programmatically (docs-1,2,9,15,25,27; probe-4). However, budgets, spend caps, and the detailed Requests/Logs dashboard are described only as UI features (docs-5,12,16,23,30) without documented API endpoints to set budgets or pull logs programmatically. Missing for 10: budgets/spend-cap management API, log/usage export API parity, team/key management API parity.
